name: seek-bar
title: Seek bar
description: The scrubber for any player: played, buffered and remaining, chapters, a time tooltip on hover, and keyboard seeking by seconds.
docs: value and duration are in seconds: feed value from timeupdate (or every animation frame for a smoother thumb) and read the visitor's choice from onSeek. buffered is a list of { start, end } ranges, and toBuffered(media.buffered), from @rhs-ui/primitives/seek-bar/time, makes it from a media element. chapters is a list of { start, title } and draws the bar in a piece for each. onSeek fires for every move of a drag, a click and each key press. onSeekStart fires when a drag begins, so you can pause. onSeekEnd fires once on release and after each key press: seek the media only there to keep video from stuttering. The thumb stays where the visitor put it until the player reports that it got there. Keys: arrows seek step seconds (5), Shift three times that, Home and End jump, Page Up and Page Down move a tenth of the length. aria-valuetext reads '1 minute 23 seconds of 4 minutes 56 seconds' (plus the chapter), or whatever valueText returns. A duration of 0, NaN or Infinity turns the bar off: it has no value, and a screen reader hears 'Length not known yet' (or what valueText(0, 0) returns) instead of '0 seconds of 0 seconds'.
